title: Anyone down to playtest Mercenaries of Tezigdal, my browser-based MOBA inspired by League of Legends? Looking for players RIGHT NOW! 🤠
author: ADIRTYHOBO59
selftext:
When I started this project I was using anything from Antigravity to Cursor but have settled on Codex with 6 Astra recently. The models are incredible for helping a developer move FAST. Though it does still take much mental effort to determine the intention that you are trying to bring into reality. That is something that models will never be capable of. Leveraging AI to fit as much of your intention as possible into your creation should be your goal!  
  
Game Title: Mercenaries of Tezigdal

Playable Link: [https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/](https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/)

Platform: \[PC\] (Web)

Description: Mercenaries of Tezigdal is an in-browser MOBA inspired by League of Legends that features some key twists. With Implements you can purchase upgrades to your base to fortify structures or increase your utility. Faculties allow you to toggle off and on base functionality to increase passive gold. Golem Craft allows you to gather crafting materials in the jungle to create more powerful waves to flood the enemy base.

Free to Play Status: Free to play

Involvement: sole developer
